notes: ARA-028 removes the ARA-022 stale authored-worktree and recursive-closeout regression and adds a persistent cross-file consistency test.
Recovery-state tests now compare CURRENT_STATE, TASK_QUEUE, RESUME_INSTRUCTIONS, and LAST_VALIDATION without invoking Git, so shallow CI checkouts remain supported.

Initial ARA-022 CI exposed a Python 3.10-only test construction bug; production behavior, Python 3.13 CI, and all local gates were green. The correction is committed/pushed as 93026ca and replacement CI passed.
ARA-022 implementation, tests, and threat-model documentation are complete, pushed, remote-equal, reflected in draft PR 13, and Python 3.10/3.13 CI-verified.
The automatic boundary registry is process-wide so worker threads and UI reruns share it; nested run roots inherit or rebase to the project anchor.
Configured external runs storage, stale real-directory tolerance, explicit analyze/compare aliases, and explicit export parents remain supported.
Survey source helpers intentionally retain lexical abspath spelling so canonicalization cannot bypass a registered boundary; persisted artifact content and repo-relative display remain unchanged.
Same-UID real-directory entry replacement, post-open or new-temp hard-link races, trusted ancestors above the anchor, and Windows active replacement are explicitly outside the guarantee.
